shared_elements: upright tall stone slab/monolith of pinkish-tan stone
incised/carved linear marks on the stone face
rows of small repeated angular sign-like marks
stone displayed indoors against a pale wall in a gallery setting
justification: Both are tall, upright pinkish stone slabs bearing incised linear sign-like marks arranged in rows, photographed in a museum interior, and A's upper zone of small vertical strokes is loosely comparable to B's rows of angular characters. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a thick, three-dimensional boulder covered edge to edge in deep curvilinear relief (discs, spirals, banded bands, an ovoid body), while B is a thin flat plaque whose surface is almost entirely blank apart from shallow scratched inscriptions confined to the margins.
